mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a weakening economy, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when RSAFS is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates supply chain disruptions or reduced manufacturing activity, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when INDPRO declines > 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals increased demand for housing and related goods, boosting economic activity and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when HOUST increases > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals reduced inflationary pressures, which can lead to a more accommodative monetary policy and increased consumer spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when CPIAUCSL decreases > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising real GDP (GDPC1) and falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a robust economic expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases > 1% and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when GDPC1 increases > 1% and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp.
